{{Color|LegendaryConsumable}} |contains = 6 }} {{QuoteContainer| {{QuoteBox|2024 Winter Consumable Crate|In-Game Description}} }} ==Description== The '''Holiday Crate''' is a consumable crate made for the [[Operation I.C.E Event]]. It contains mostly consumables made for the event, though it also contains the [[Blizzard Bomb]] as it is a cold themed consumable. The main method of obtainment is getting it through event related activities, like the [[Operation I.C.E Event|Operation I.C.E Battlepass]], though it could be bought for {{Robux|32}} in the store. It gives five consumables when opened. ==Former Methods of Obtaining== #Purchase in the store for {{Robux|32}}. #*This could be repeated multiple times. #*Due to underage gambling laws, you were unable to use this method if you are in the Netherlands, Australia or Belgium. Additionally, players who could not verify their age to be over 18 in the United Kingdom could not also use this method. #Chance upon triumphing a match of [[Outpost 32 (Operation I.C.E)]]. #*This could be repeated multiple times. #Level 2, 4, 13, 23 and 28 of the [[Operation I.C.E Event|Operation I.C.E Battlepass]]. ==Consumables== {| class="light-table align-center pad-5" style="width:300px; margin:0 auto" ! |[[File:FruitCakeConsumable.png|150px]] |[[File:PresentClusterBombConsumable.png|150px]] |[[File:FestiveTreeConsumable.png|150px]] |[[File:Santa'sAirStrikeConsumable.png|150px]] |- !Rarity |{{Color|Common}} |{{Color|Uncommon}} |{{Color|Rare}} |{{Color|Rare}} |- !Percentage |26.25% |31.25% |16.67% |16.67% |- !Consumable |[[Fruit Cake]] |[[Present Cluster Bomb]] |[[Festive Tree]] |[[Santa's Air Strike]] |- ! |[[File:BlizzardBombIcon.png|150px]] |[[File:MoltenMonsterConsumable.png|150px]] |- !Rarity |{{Color|Epic}} |{{Color|LegendaryConsumable}} |- !Percentage |8.33% |0.83% |- !Consumable |[[Blizzard Bomb]] |[[Molten Monster (Consumable)|Molten Monster]] |} ==Gallery== {{Gallery| {{GalleryHeader|Crate Icons}} HolidayCrate.png|First version (16 December 2024 – 22 April 2026) }} ==Trivia== *The '''Holiday Crate''' is the first event consumable crate. In the previous event with event consumables, that being the [[Hexscape Event]], they were put in regular crates instead. *The '''Holiday Crate''' actually has "''crate''" in its name. This means that, in a few places where "''crate''" is added to the end of crate names automatically, the name of it will be displayed as "''Holiday Crate crate''". *The {{Robux|32}} price may be a reference to [[Outpost 32 (Operation I.C.E)|Outpost 32]], or the 32 meme within the Tower Defense Simulator community. ==Update History== *'''16 December 2024''' - [[v1.46.0]] **'''Holiday Crate''' added. *'''1 April 2025''' - [[v1.59.0]] **'''Holiday Crate''' taken offsale. {{CrateNavBox}}
